idea: How do incorrect conclusions get drawn from agents summarising/reviewing transcripts? Study systematic failure modes of agent-mediated transcript review: prompt sensitivity, audience-conditioning, perspective adoption (the METR Sol precedent), motivated reasoning from leaked researcher expectations, and whether cross-model review decorrelates errors. Seed materials already exist in the work repo (see project.toml [work].repo): context.md there carries the pulled Slack/Drive context; the transcript corpus is at github.com/ArcadiaImpact/arch-run-transcripts.
